# A Front Door {#sec-a-front-door}

{{< credits 09-a-front-door >}}

::: {.callout-important}
## Draft
This chapter is an outline. Want to help write it? Start with @sec-your-first-contribution.
:::

## Goal

Make the lab feel like a product, with one place to reach everything.

## The big idea

URLs, hostnames and local domain names.

## Outline

- A dashboard like Homepage
- Adding each service with status widgets
- Friendly local names instead of IP addresses and port numbers
- Reverse proxy as an optional stretch

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
Change a service's port and update the dashboard to find it again.
:::
